name: tablekit
description: Glue and instrumentation for a live tabletop game where some seats are AI agents. Produces one append-only JSONL per session that is simultaneously the play ledger (dmcheck-compatible) and a five-lane telemetry stream: qa (did the machinery work), qc (was the refereeing correct), ux (what the seat's evening looked like), uxr (how it felt from a seat - inferred from ordinary speech during play, then asked about conversationally at the close), out (outcome pairs recording whether a craft move actually worked).

subcommands.init [path]: Write a starter table.json. Exit 2 if the file exists.
subcommands.beat \"<text>\" [--cue SEAT] [--chunks N: Record a GM beat; opens a cue pair and checks the cue is deliverable. Exit 1 if the cue would be dropped in transit.
subcommands.inbound --seat S --text \"...\" [--pair: Record what a seat said (who spoke and how much; prose is not stored by default). Closing a compatible cue/checkin pair requires --pair ID even when only one candidate is open; missing correlation is quarantined and the candidate IDs remain visible. Player text is never parsed for commands or keywords.
subcommands.consumed <pair-id> [--outcome ...]: Close one explicit pair using an outcome valid for that pair kind. Exit 2 for unknown, closed, mismatched, or invalid lifecycle transitions.
subcommands.checkin --seat S: Record checking on a quiet seat and open a checkin pair; resolve it only with an explicitly correlated inbound.
subcommands.turn --seat S [--wait N]: Record that a seat got the floor.
subcommands.qc [--state FILE] [--record] [--json]: Run the checks. Exit 1 if there are findings.
subcommands.sweep: Close pairs past their TTL with named outcomes. Exit 1 if any expired.
subcommands.report [--json] [--out FILE]: Post-session report. Exit 0 clean, 1 defects or unresolved routing quarantines, 2 not enough data.
subcommands.schema: Event schema, route statuses, typed pair outcomes, signal buckets and exit codes as JSON.
subcommands.signal --seat S --kind pacing --quote \": Record a signal inferred from what a player already said. Buckets: pacing, floor, comprehension, resonance, spotlight, continuity. The quote is mandatory - an inference without evidence cannot be audited. Advisory always; can never become a defect.
subcommands.debrief: With no arguments, print the plain-English close-out questions to ask in your own words. With --seat/--q/--a, record an answer.

output: Human-readable text by default; --json where offered. The session file is JSONL, one object per line, every line carrying ts and type.

transport.write_default: disabled; transport.write_enabled must be the JSON boolean true
transport.inspect: Python: post.prepare(cfg, text, cue=..., operation_id=...) returns the immutable bounded payload plan without ledger or network I/O.
transport.deliver: Python: post.post(...) returns disabled, invalid, failed, partial, or committed. Only committed is complete delivery. Persist operation_id; post.resume(...) reconstructs the complete bounded plan from the ledger after interruption.
transport.safety: Unintended mentions are denied; only the explicit cue target can ping once. Every chunk is bounded and nonce-protected; successes are durably receipted, and interrupted unreceipted delivery is remotely reconciled before resume can resend. Live enablement remains gated by docs/TRANSPORT.md.

notes: Three contracts the tool will not bend. (1) THE TABLE SPEAKS ENGLISH: players are never given a command syntax, token vocabulary or keywords - text RPGs did that because 1980s parsers could not understand sentences, and an agent GM that reintroduces it throws away its only advantage over a parser game. Enforced by tests. All commands here are operator-side. (2) An inferred signal is advisory in every path and can never become a defect. (3) Below three occurrences the report lists individual moments and refuses to state a rate. No composite score is produced anywhere, by design.

exit_codes.2: refused — bad input or not enough data

related.dmcheck: table conduct; reads this kit's session file directly
